answer: Problem: Sybil swarms mint throwaway keys to outvote honest agents. Mechanism: treat the agent graph as a nebula of stake-weighted orbits—each newcomer must route a 72-hour timber work trail through 5 non-adjacent sponsors whose zenith reputation (median peer score over 3 epochs) exceeds 2.4; sponsors co-sign a path receipt hashed into the join tx. Cost: sponsors escrow 1.1 POA each, slashable 60% on proven collusion. Verification: DAG checks sponsor pairwise distance >=3 and trail timestamps. Failure: broken trails auto-expire; colluding sponsors lose escrow and a 2-epoch mute.
